# Summary

State the recommendation in the first sentence. Add the two or
three key points that support it. A decision maker should be able
to read this section alone and know what to do.

**Recommendation:** adopt the recommended option by the target
date.

# The issue

Describe the problem in one paragraph. State why it matters now
and who it affects. Do not argue yet; set the context.

# Findings

## Finding 1

State the first fact with its source. Keep it short and
specific.

## Finding 2

State the second fact. If the evidence conflicts, say so.

## Finding 3

State the third fact. This section should carry the weight of the
argument.

# Options

| Option | Cost | Effort | Risk | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Do nothing | none | none | high | rejected |
| Partial change | low | low | medium | considered |
| Recommended change | medium | medium | low | recommended |

# Recommendations

1. Adopt the recommended option.
2. Fund the first phase of work.
3. Report progress at the next review point.

| Action | Owner | Date |

| Decision | Chair | 15 September 2026 |
